notes: 北殿与东西两间完整医舍共同围成王都内廷，两处病房门朝南；南侧照护院与后撤门由中轴相连，形成内廷而非散落村舍。
伤兵在已打开的病房门槛等待接应，确认后沿南门横廊汇入中轴；横向院墙限制向南抄近路，接应队可守中央缺口与东侧来援巷。
队伍部署在南院，药车和庭园在道路两旁；先压住东医舍附近守军再放行，更容易保护两组伤兵。两病房都要确认、至少一组撤离及第4回合来援不变。
登天桥由三段真正跨水的石桥、两处承台与东西岸桥头组成；每段保持三格净通行宽度，护栏在通行带外，桥两端都落在完整石台上。
三个桥锁从西到东依次位于落脚承台，使用可通行的控制标记，不用封闭门图阻断已连通的桥面；原先后确认规则保持。
承台南侧留出待机与整队支台，可避免全队挤入桥口；飞行者可越水绕侧，但仍需正式确认三段桥锁，东岸和西岸来援通道均有实际落脚地。

render_method: current Godot renderer via capture_campaign.sh background_guard
cross_review: map_design_critique inspected both whole maps; no blocking entry/bridge landing defects. Sea-edge grass seam was subsequently removed and rechecked.
M51: Both south-facing ward approaches match their building fronts. Ward confirmation unlocks waiting NPCs; it does not mutate collision. Southern crosswall and three-cell gaps constrain actual escort AI to paved medical corridors and south exit. Both ordinary move-2 escorts reached the exit in isolated actual movement fixtures.
M52: All three spans have three clear walking rows, blocked rail cells outside those rows, complete landings at both ends, support piers with waiting space, and strictly increasing west-to-east bridge-lock X positions. Flags denote passable controls, with no false closed gate.
scope: Static geometry, actual movement/early-AI navigation fixture and background visual review. Complete ordinary-input campaign play is documented separately by root.
